extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism ontology replacement. Placeholder automated terms were removed; claims are limited to HIV fusion/entry inhibition and gp41 NHR target-mimic binding supported by local XML tables, captions, and prose.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: LP-80/LP-90 and related lipopeptides inhibit HIV-1 Env-mediated cell-cell fusion, pseudovirus entry, and replication-competent HIV-1 infection.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LP-80, LP-90, LP-52, T-20, C34-Chol/VRC01 comparators where table-specific
mechanism_claims.limitations: Functional inhibition supports HIV fusion/entry inhibitor activity; it is not evidence for nonspecific membrane permeabilization, nucleic-acid binding, or protein-synthesis inhibition.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: CD spectroscopy with N39 target mimic supports interaction between lipopeptides and a gp41 NHR-derived target mimic peptide, with increased helicity/thermal stability recorded in Table 1/Fig 3.
mechanism_claims.entity_scope: LP-52, LP-77, LP-78, LP-79, LP-80, LP-81, LP-82, LP-88, LP-89, LP-90, LP-91, LP-92 in complex with N39
assay_types: thermal stability with N39 target mimic
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biophysical target-mimic binding is supportive mechanism context; no direct structural complex or precise binding constant is extracted from the local packet.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: In vivo rhesus macaque viral suppression is pharmacodynamic efficacy evidence for LP-80, not a separate molecular mechanism claim.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Does not establish an additional direct antimicrobial mechanism beyond fusion/entry inhibition.
